headline: Xi Jinping advocates for free trade and AI cooperation at APEC summit
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping called for open trade and the elimination of investment barriers at an APEC summit, following expanded US export restrictions on advanced artificial intelligence semiconductors.
why: Geopolitical friction and semiconductor trade restrictions between the US and China shape supply chains for global electronics, hardware, and foundry manufacturers.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: China is pushing back against US restrictions on advanced chip technology at international forums.
